subject: Affiliate preview access & limited promo credit — approval request
body:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie@launchlane.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: events@launchlane.io
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: preview access + promo credit for affiliate preview

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. LaunchLane is running a small invite-only preview for 120 of our community partners next Tuesday and we wanted to offer attendees a short Redwood trial window (two weeks) plus a small promo credit to test the hosted inference workflows.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Issue 120 two-week trial activations tied to the LaunchLane org (attendee list attached).
- Reserve a one-time promo credit pool of $1,500 to be applied to those trials (split into $12.50 per account).

We can push the activation emails after you confirm rolling distribution timing. If there are policy or compliance checks we should do first, flag them and we’ll pause.

Attachments: preview-attendee-list.csv

Best,
Sophie Turner
Partnerships Manager, LaunchLane
---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@launchlane.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: preview access + promo credit for affiliate preview

Sophie — thanks for the details and the list. Looping in Monica (partner ops) and Mateo (growth) to confirm budget and fulfillment timeline. Quick notes:

- We can do 2-week trial activations scoped to the event org. Prefer to provision via a single bulk onramp so we can set entitlement and expiry centrally.
- The $1,500 pool is reasonable but I need internal signoff for that exact amount (quota + accounting).
- Two operational asks: confirm attendee emails are hashed/consented for marketing and whether any attendees are from EU (affects data region).

Monica/Mateo — can you review the attached list and the attached promo policy I’m including (promo-credit-policy.pdf) and confirm:
  * finance OK with $1,500 one-time promo?
  * can eng/ops schedule a staggered roll this week so attendees receive invites on Monday morning PTA?

Happy to do a 15-min call if that helps.

— Marissa
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 11:20 AM, monica_patel@redwood.com wrote:
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, Sophie Turner <sophie@launchlane.io>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: preview access + promo credit for affiliate preview

Marissa & Sophie — reviewed attendee CSV and promo policy. Finance flag: $1,500 one-time is OK as a marketing promo under the partner credit budget, subject to the following guardrails:

- Issue credits as a single promo code per attendee that expires at the end of the two-week trial window.
- Cap redemptions to the LaunchLane org to prevent cross-org usage.
- Attribution string must include "LaunchLane Preview Sept 2026" for tracking.

Operational notes:
- Ops can do a staggered rollout in three waves (Mon 09:00, Mon 15:00, Tue 09:00 PST) to smooth backend load.
- I’ll upload the promo code distribution sheet to the shared Drive and send the code generation request to EngOps now.

Attached: promo-credit-policy.pdf (internal summary of promo limits).

Monica Patel
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Sep 30, 2026 at 16:45:00-07:00, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com wrote:
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie@launchlane.io>
Date: 2026-09-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: preview access + promo credit for affiliate preview — Approved

All — greenlight from Growth and Finance. Deal DL-2026-0897 is updated in HubSpot with the promo allocation. Action items I’ve assigned:

1) EngOps: generate 120 unique promo codes, each with $12.50 credit, attach attribution string and org-scoped restriction.
2) Ops: schedule staggered email sends per Monica’s slots; include brief usage tips and a link to the onboarding doc.
3) Partnerships: Sophie — please confirm you want us to include the optional quickstart session invite in the activation email.

I’ll mark the deal stage as "Fulfillment Scheduling". Thanks team — call if anything unexpected pops up.

— Mateo Alvarez
Growth PM, Redwood Inference

On Wed, Sep 30, 2026 at 17:02:00-07:00, Sophie Turner <sophie@launchlane.io> wrote:
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: preview access + promo credit for affiliate preview — Approved

Amazing — thanks so much. Yes please include the quickstart session invite (Tue 11:00 PST) in the activation email. We’ll be on standby for any follow-up.

Best,
Sophie
